items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022

ctx.x: I think I read that when a new person came on that Woody would sort of give them a trial? Would hire them for a period of time to see if they were going to fit in?

Well you know he would have them play and of course I mean if they weren’t good you know at that time you could buy tickets at the airport right at the counter. So I mean he would let them go. But one example was — oh God, my friend — Oh I’m trying to think —Joe Lovano.
